countries: The United Republics of Brightport and Occasue. Holds the whole west coast of its continent.
Borders URBO to the north, on the Schoon Sea. Also shows a city read as Doonshied ?.
Cities read as El Niso ? and St. Ptrawen ?.
A small country on Joya’s eastern side.
continents: Uropon is the larger eastern continent, home to Rhine, Instania and Guinesem.
Asuna is the smaller continent south of Uropon, with Juku, Tinsha and New China.
Anracia is the western continent, home to URBO, Schoonheid, Joya and Shinchied.
notes: The dashed blue lines are early shipping routes from Brightport, as drawn on the 2180 map.
The First Nyreth World War (NWWI) was a global skirmish. Schoonheid lost its west coast in it, and it led on to the Brightportish civil war.
The area inside Guinesem is disputed territory.
changes: URBO now holds the whole west coast of its continent. On the 2180 drawing, Schoonheid wrapped around the north-west.
Swisswa, once a Schoonheid town on that coast, is now a town in Ouest. Many Schoon loyalists remain there.
The Brightport colony of Twinshied became Norham, and now lies closer to the mainland, off the south-east coast.
On the drawing, Brightport was one republic. It is shown here as the two republics of URBO.
open: Readings marked ? need checking: Doonsline, Doonshied, El Niso, St. Ptrawen, Donborg, Iseton, Paflonia.

planet: On Nyreth the sun rises in the west and sets in the east, because the planet spins the opposite way to Earth.
Because of that spin, the prevailing winds over URBO blow from east to west, so storms usually arrive from the east.

solis.origin: The sun on every Brightport flag began as the emblem of Solis, and the state is named for it: Solis means “of the sun.” The first colony ships landed here, and Brightport City grew from their landing camp.
solis.known: Solis is the nation’s finance and business hub, home to the ministries, the banks and the national stock exchange in Brightport City. The Souvren lives here, which gives the state its nickname.
trad: The Festival of Lanterns: on the longest night, lanterns float down the Brightport River.
solis.symbol: The rising sun, shown on the shield of the Solis flag.

floribus.origin: Settlers found the coast covered in wildflowers every spring, so they named it Floribus, “with flowers.”
floribus.known: Floribus is the nation’s warm-weather getaway, known for its beaches and holidays. The Port of Trempas, flower and fruit farms and seafood from Trempas Bay keep its economy busy all year.
trad: The Blessing of the Fleet: each season the fishing boats of Trempas Bay are decorated and blessed.
floribus.climate: Warm and breezy, with sea breezes keeping it mild all year.

estercrystal.origin: Settlers found caves of glittering quartz in the eastern hills and named the land for them; “ester” means east.
estercrystal.known: Estercrystal is known for gems and glassmaking: crystal mines in the hills and famous glassworks in its shires.
trad: Crystal Night: on the first night of winter, crystal lamps and candles set in crystals light every window.

weiden.origin: The name comes from a lost word of the first settlers, meaning “high country.”
weiden.known: Weiden is known for skiing and winter sports on the slopes around Bikbergen.
trad: Midsummer Night: bonfires, maypoles, flower crowns and dancing on the longest day.
weiden.symbol: A water-mill wheel: mills on its mountain streams powered the first settlements.

sur.origin: Settlers from Earth’s Spanish-speaking south named it in their own language: Sur, “south.” Nobody remembers where the name of Mami City comes from; it is lost to time.
sur.known: Sur is known for copper mining in its mesas, around the town of Cobre.
trad: Farolito Night: paper lanterns line every roof, street and path in winter.

norham.origin: The islanders voted to join Brightport for protection and trade. Norham added the sixth ray to the sun on Brightport’s flags.
norham.known: Norham is one of the wealthiest places in URBO, an island retreat for old money, much like Nantucket. Its harbour still lands the nation’s best seafood.
trad: The Harbour Festival: boat parades and seafood stalls along the Silverstone waterfront.
norham.more: Norham is known, not always kindly, for its snobbery. Islanders speak with a posh accent that mainlanders love to imitate.
norham.transport: Robust public transport: the Island Railway loop, island buses to every village, and a ferry to Brightport City. Lochway N1 links Silverstone and Harbourmouth.

deserto.origin: Ft. Deserto was founded as the base of the first expedition to cross the desert.
deserto.known: Deserto is known for huge solar farms and large, very secretive military installations. Stories of aliens are part of local culture, a running joke on a planet where the aliens are the humans from Earth.
trad: The Night Market: markets open only after sunset, when the desert cools.

kus.origin: The name comes from the Dutch word “kust,” coast, brought by early Dutch settlers.
kus.known: Kus is home to Berevo, the capital of Occasue and the political heart of the republic.
trad: Republic Day: celebrates Occasue choosing a president over a monarch.

ouest.origin: Ouest is named after the French settlers’ company, the Compagnie du Grand Ouest.
ouest.known: Ouest is known for French food and wine: bread, cheese, vineyards and village markets.
trad: The Fête du Vin, a week-long wine festival.
ouest.more: The coastal town of Swisswa once belonged to Schoonheid. It still resents being taken into URBO, and many Schoon loyalists live there.

lochwater-state.origin: Homesick Scottish settlers named it after the lochs they missed on Earth.
lochwater-state.known: Lochwater’s lochs supply fresh drinking water to much of Occasue.
trad: The Music Weekend: pipers and fiddlers from every shire fill the city of Lochwater.

polvo.origin: Polvo means “dust,” after the dust storms that blow across its basins.
polvo.known: Polvo is known for salt and lithium, mined from the Salinas flats.
trad: The Big Rodeo: a week of rodeo and fairs in Polvo Springs.

montes.origin: Montes stayed a territory because the mountains are too remote for enough people to live there.
montes.known: Montes holds the highest peaks on the continent.
montes.quiet: Not much happens here. Montes is very sparsely settled.

subdiv_none.norham: Norham has no subdivisions. The island is governed as a single unit from Silverstone.
subdiv_none.deserto: Deserto Territory has no subdivisions. It is run directly by the Brightport government from Ft. Deserto.
subdiv_none.montes: Montes Territory has no subdivisions. It is run directly by the Occasue government.

subdiv_note.Shires: Each shire takes a traditional Scottish name ending in -shire.
subdiv_note.Herreds: The herred is an old Scandinavian district, kept by Weiden’s settlers.

levels.name: URBO federal government
levels.body: URBO National Parliament: the Assembly and the Council of States
facts: Addresses matters affecting the union as a whole.
A forum where disputes between the two republics are resolved collectively, with the states taking part.
URBO has a president and a prime minister: a French-style system with elements of the British Commonwealth.
The URBO president and the Souvren of Brightport rule the union jointly.
The URBO president is a separate office from the president of Occasue. The URBO president is elected by popular vote every five years, with no limit on terms.
The URBO president and the Souvren are co-heads of the union, a little like Andorra’s two co-princes. Unlike Andorra’s, they cannot act separately: they must agree together on URBO matters.
When the president and the Souvren disagree, the parliament and the high court mediate and keep the balance of power.
The Assembly (lower house) has 300 seats, one for about every million people, shared out by population. Every state and territory has at least one.
The Council of States (upper house) has 32 seats: 3 for each of the 10 states and 1 for each territory.
Parliament is elected for 5 years, in step with the URBO president.
The URBO prime minister alternates between the republics: after each parliamentary election, the office passes to the other republic.
Current: Souvren Élise I and President Henrik Aalders; Prime Minister Oliver Ashcombe (Brightport’s term).
open: Division of powers with the republics
Whether URBO law overrides republic law

levels.name: Republic of Brightport
facts: Passes laws for Brightport and keeps its own political and cultural identity.
Six states and Deserto Territory.
Uses Brightportish more widely, especially in national institutions.
Head of state and sovereign: the Souvren, a monarch in the Belgian style, a people’s sovereign rather than a ruler of the land.
Brightportish people are proud of their Souvren.
The name “Republic of Brightport” stuck from the early days. With the Souvren in place, people saw no need to change it.

The Souvren’s line is hereditary, under the Gardiens, a council elected by the nation. The Gardiens decide whether the Souvren is fit to serve and whether their family is fit to continue the line. If not, the nation votes for a new line.
Brightport has its own prime minister, who heads the lower house of the Brightport Parliament.
Current Souvren: Élise I of the House of Brightwell, the first woman to reign. Prime minister: Nathaniel Fairbourne.
open: Whether it has its own constitution

levels.name: Republic of Occasue
facts: Passes laws for Occasue and keeps its own political and cultural identity.
Four states and Montes Territory.
Favours ancestral Earth languages, with Brightportish secondary.
A counterweight to Brightport City.
Occasue rejected the monarchy. It has a president and a prime minister.
The president is head of state; the prime minister runs the government, as in France.
Current president: Amélie Rousseau-Kerr. Prime minister: Ewan Dunmore.
open: Whether it has its own constitution

levels.name: State governments
facts: Handle matters within their jurisdiction, broadly like US state legislatures.
Take part in representing their republic within the federal system.
Each state is one ray on its republic’s sun.

levels.name: Territorial governments
facts: Parallel to states, not beneath them.
Remain territories because of remoteness and harsh terrain; Deserto has developed around Ft. Deserto.
Do not count toward flag rays.

eras.name: Earth colonization
eras.summary: Settlers from different Earth countries found cultural and linguistic communities on Nyreth.

eras.name: Republic of Brightport
eras.summary: The original yellow country between Schoonheid and Joya, governed from Brightport City: seven states, Deserto Territory and the capital territory.

eras.name: Growing disagreements
eras.summary: Western states grow dissatisfied with centralization in Brightport City, economic neglect and disregard for western culture. The conflict builds gradually, not from one event.

eras.name: First Nyreth World War (NWWI)
eras.summary: A global skirmish among the countries of Nyreth. Schoonheid lost its west coast, which is now part of URBO, and the war led on to the Brightportish civil war.

eras.name: Civil war
eras.summary: A relatively short and not especially bloody war shows the unified republic is politically unsustainable.

eras.name: Peace treaty
eras.summary: The country is formally divided into Brightport and Occasue. Laws, currency, road signs, borders and institutions change; the treaty includes provisions for divided families.

eras.name: Early separation
eras.summary: For the first few years the new international border has extensive checkpoints and controls.

eras.name: Rapprochement
eras.summary: Within a few years relations improve greatly. Together the two republics are a major power on Nyreth. Hardliners in Berevo oppose closer ties.

eras.name: URBO
eras.summary: The republics form a shared federal system, as if the US and the EU had a baby. Checkpoints are removed and people move freely across the union. Each republic keeps its own government.

entities.name: Nyreth
facts: Colonized by humans from Earth in the 2100s.
Multiple continents, oceans and polar ice caps.
Several moons appear in the Brightport City pencil skyline.
open: Number, names and sizes of moons

entities.name: Republic of Brightport
facts: The original yellow country, stretching from the Fliwth Ocean to the Nybeps Ocean.
Seven states, Deserto Territory and a small capital territory.
Capital: Brightport City.
Brightportish became a shared lingua franca alongside the colonial languages.
open: Official unified flag (the flag on the world map is marked “wrong flag”)

entities.name: United Republics of Brightport and Occasue
facts: A federal union of two republics: as if the US federal system and the EU had a baby, with an identity of its own.
Union capital: Brightport City, where the old Brightport City elite kept their influence after the war.
Freedom of movement: after a few years of checkpoints, the border between the republics opened.
Flag: vertical red-left, yellow-right bicolour with a central sun of ten rays, one per state.
open: Division of union and republic powers

entities.name: Brightport (eastern republic)
facts: Eastern successor republic within URBO.
Capital: Brightport City.
Flag: yellow field with the sun; six rays for its six states, including Norham.
Uses Brightportish more prominently than the west.

entities.name: Occasue
facts: Western republic within URBO, formed from the western states after the civil war.
Capital: Berevo.
Flag: red field with the sun; four rays for its four states.
Generally favours Earth heritage languages, with Brightportish secondary.

entities.name: Schoonheid
facts: Northern neighbour, founded by Scandinavian countries.
Its languages merged over generations into a distinct Scandinavian-derived language.
“The Canadian Republic”, written over it on two drawings, was a discarded idea.

entities.name: Joya
facts: Southern neighbour, founded by Mexico and other Spanish-speaking countries.
Spanish dialects merged into a national variety.
open: Is Joya City (starred on the world map) the capital?

entities.name: Republic of Rhime
facts: East/northeast of the Nybeps Ocean.

entities.name: Federal republic (name unclear)
facts: Red country on the eastern landmass; a city labelled New London.

entities.name: Shinenied
facts: Southeast of Joya.

entities.name: Asuna
facts: Near the southeastern edge.

entities.name: Tisha
facts: Near the southeastern edge.

entities.name: Island marked as a Brightport colony
facts: Small island in the Nybeps Ocean, labelled as a Brightport colony.

entities.name: Fliwth Ocean
facts: Western ocean; also appears at the far right edge of the world map.

entities.name: Nybeps Ocean
facts: Eastern ocean, between the Brightport continent and the landmass to the east.

entities.name: Schoon Sea
facts: Named in the northwest of the world map.

entities.name: Brightport River
facts: Brightport City stands on it.
Crosses the capital diagonally on the city plan.

entities.name: Fliwth Passage
facts: River or waterway reaching the Fliwth Ocean near Berevo.

entities.name: Trempas Bay
facts: Large eastern bay, Tampa-inspired.

entities.name: Ouest
facts: Northwestern state, settled by the French.
French cultural and linguistic influence.
Survives the war as a state of Occasue.

entities.name: Estercrystal
facts: Large north-central state with Scottish influence.
Before the war its capital was Lochwater.
After the war it is a state of eastern Brightport; Lochwater becomes a separate western state.

entities.name: Weiden
facts: Northeastern state, settled by Scandinavians.
Capital: Bikbergen. Secondary city: Bönderbil.

entities.name: Kus
facts: Southwestern state, settled mostly by the Dutch, with Americans too.
Cities: Berevo and Costal City.
After the war, Berevo is the capital of Occasue.

entities.name: Sur
facts: South-central state, founded by American and Mexican settlers thrown off course during colonization.
A New Mexico-like blend of cultures.
Capital: Mami City.

entities.name: Floribus
facts: Eastern state, settled by Americans, inspired by Florida.
Trempas and the Port of Trempas on a large bay.

entities.name: Scønhed
facts: Southeastern state, settled by Danish colonists.
Small and sparsely populated; surrounds the capital territory.
Dissolved after the war and replaced by Solis.

entities.name: Deserto Territory
facts: Harsh central desert, too difficult for the first settlers.
Settled by independent Brightport, not by an Earth nation.
A territory, not a state. Home to Ft. Deserto.

entities.name: Capital territory
facts: Small territory containing Brightport City, enclosed by Scønhed, like the ACT within New South Wales.
Too small to show on a national map; marked by the capital symbol.

entities.name: Solis
facts: Replaced the dissolved Scønhed.
The name plays on the sun motif and the Brightport government’s fondness for Latin.
Surrounds Brightport City.

entities.name: Lochwater (state)
facts: New western state formed after the split, named for the city of Lochwater.
open: Whether the city of Lochwater is its capital

entities.name: Polvo
facts: New western state formed after the split.

entities.name: Montes Territory
facts: Remote, harsh western territory formed after the split.
Less developed than Deserto with Ft. Deserto.

entities.name: Norham
facts: Oceanic state of the Brightport republic: an island east/southeast of the mainland, marked BP on one map.
A later addition to the union; it adds a ray to the Brightport and URBO suns.
Settlement: Silverstone.
Has a sector in the parliament plan.

entities.name: Brightport City
facts: Capital of the unified republic, of eastern Brightport and of URBO.
Huge inland metropolis on the Brightport River, not on the ocean.

Dense skyscrapers: a dominant tall rectangular tower with a pointed crown, towers with pink and gold crowns, a tower with green vegetation, an observation-like tower and a small arched or domed structure near the water.

Photorealistic photograph, set around the year 2200 on a human-colonized planet: advanced but plausible, not cyberpunk, not fantasy, no flying cars. Natural light, real architectural photography.

sample.bp:
Brightport is our countri. Wi livons in different states, et wi talkons different langues, bot wi ar wun people.
Wi avons our own historie, our own culture et our own langue. Brightportish is the langue of our nation.
sample.en: Brightport is our country. We live in different states, and we speak different languages, but we are one people. We have our own history, our own culture and our own language. Brightportish is the language of our nation.
